round1_dispositions.evidence: Consent is asked at Connect (D3); the Inbox card and call-start trigger are gone. Rejected and declined paths: declining means not pressing Connect. Evidence step-3.png.
One provider list and one pane; one Connected tag per row (step-4.png). A related question remains as N1.
The Transcription select no longer exists; Disconnect goes back to the Default pane.
Heading "Voice sharing has changed" removed; remaining new strings are quoted in the HTML comment for the PR.
Author notes moved into HTML comments; none visible in step-1..4 screenshots.

new_findings.description: After Connect nothing says Flow is now the transcriber. ElevenLabs stays Connected and is also "Speak + transcribe", and the only cue for the active provider is a subtle highlight on the selected row. A user cannot tell which provider hears them, or how to switch back other than Disconnect.
new_findings.suggested_fix: State in S3a whether Connect makes Flow the transcriber and how selecting an ElevenLabs/OpenAI row changes it; if it does, show the active one with the existing check or "Connected" tag only.
